blocks.zh: 本節學習重點（p69–p78）
blocks.en: Key Points of This Section (p69–p78)

blocks.zh: 理解發生機率（Probability of Occurrence）分析的系統性架構與觸發條件
blocks.en: Understand the systematic framework and trigger conditions for probability of occurrence analysis

blocks.zh: 掌握生產操作活動（秤量、混合、壓錠、充填、造粒）對交叉污染風險的影響因素
blocks.en: Master how production operations (weighing, blending, compression, filling, granulation) influence cross-contamination risk

blocks.zh: 辨識非生產活動（清潔、維護保養、更換批次）中潛在的交叉污染路徑
blocks.en: Identify potential cross-contamination routes in non-production activities (cleaning, maintenance, changeover)

blocks.zh: 評估廠房與設備設計（HVAC、密閉/開放系統、排水）對風險的影響
blocks.en: Assess the effect of facility and equipment design (HVAC, closed/open systems, drainage) on risk

blocks.zh: 了解非產品接觸區域（Non-Product Contact Areas）的定義與殘留物評估
blocks.en: Understand the definition of non-product contact areas and the assessment of residues there

blocks.zh: 理解偵測（Detection）方法在風險評分中的角色，包括分析方法充分性與藥典比對
blocks.en: Understand the role of detection methods in risk scoring, including adequacy of analytical methods and comparison with compendia

blocks.en: Contents of This Section

blocks.en: 6.4 Probability of Occurrence 6.4.1 Production Process Activities 6.4.2 Non-Processing Activities 6.4.3 Facility and Equipment Design 6.5 Product Exposure Risk in Non-Product Contact Areas 6.6 Detection

blocks.zh: Probability of Occurrence — 發生機率
blocks.en: Probability of Occurrence

blocks.zh: p69–p70 | 系統性識別所有操作條件下的交叉污染潛在路徑
blocks.en: p69–p70 | Systematically identify potential cross-contamination routes under all operating conditions

blocks.zh: 繁體中文解析與Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：發生機率（Probability of Occurrence）
blocks.en: Core Concept: Probability of Occurrence

blocks.zh: 發生機率是交叉污染風險評估三個維度之一（另兩個為嚴重性與可偵測性）。本節要求對所有操作條件下的潛在污染路徑進行系統性、詳細的審查，而非僅限於正常生產狀態。
blocks.en: Probability of occurrence is one of the three dimensions of cross-contamination risk assessment (the other two are severity and detectability). This section requires a systematic, detailed review of potential contamination routes under all operating conditions, not only normal production.

blocks.zh: 評估不只在新廠房設計時執行，任何產品變更、設備改造、製程調整都須觸發重新評估。
blocks.en: The assessment is not performed only at the design stage of a new facility; any product change, equipment modification or process adjustment must trigger a reassessment.

blocks.zh: 高風險情境識別——稽查重點
blocks.en: Identifying High-Risk Scenarios — Inspection Focus

blocks.zh: 以下情境會顯著提高失敗機率，是監管稽查常見關注點：
blocks.en: The following scenarios significantly raise the probability of failure and are common focus areas for regulatory inspections:

blocks.zh: 手動操作：依賴人員技術，一致性低
blocks.en: Manual operations: depend on personnel skill; low consistency

blocks.zh: 歷史上不穩定的製程或設備：有既往失敗記錄
blocks.en: Historically unstable processes or equipment: with a record of past failures

blocks.zh: 特定操作節點：批次啟動、批次切換、班次交接、保養後復工
blocks.en: Specific operating nodes: batch start-up, batch changeover, shift handover, restart after maintenance

blocks.zh: 新人員、未受訓人員、人員更換：增加操作偏差風險
blocks.en: New, untrained or replaced personnel: increase the risk of operating deviations

blocks.zh: 稽查員常要求廠商提供針對這些節點的專項風險評估或SOP控制措施。
blocks.en: Inspectors often ask the company to provide a dedicated risk assessment or SOP controls for these nodes.

blocks.zh: 思考類比：飛機安全檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: Aircraft Safety Checks

blocks.zh: 發生機率評估就像航空業的安全評估——不只審查正常飛行，也要審查起飛、降落、地勤、換機師等每個交接節點。製藥廠的「批次切換」與「班次交接」就是這些最容易出問題的節點。
blocks.en: Probability assessment is like safety assessment in aviation: it reviews not only normal flight but also takeoff, landing, ground handling and crew changes, every handover node. In a pharma plant, "batch changeover" and "shift handover" are the nodes where things most easily go wrong.

blocks.zh: Production Process Activities — 生產製程活動
blocks.en: Production Process Activities

blocks.zh: p70–p71 | 操作狀態、製程特性、暴露因素全面評估
blocks.en: p70–p71 | Comprehensive assessment of operating states, process characteristics and exposure factors

blocks.zh: FAT的盲點——常見稽查缺失
blocks.en: The Blind Spot of FAT — a Common Inspection Deficiency

blocks.zh: 許多廠房在設備驗收測試（FAT）時評估密閉性，但FAT通常在最佳操作條件下進行，並不涵蓋以下高風險節點：
blocks.en: Many plants assess containment during the factory acceptance test (FAT), but the FAT is usually performed under optimal operating conditions and does not cover the following high-risk nodes:

blocks.zh: 設備安裝與設定（Set up）
blocks.en: Equipment installation and set up

blocks.zh: 人工干預（刮取、取樣、端點判定）
blocks.en: Manual interventions (scraping, sampling, end-point determination)

blocks.zh: 設備故障（Upset）
blocks.en: Equipment failure (upset)

blocks.zh: 拆卸與清潔（Disassembly / Cleaning）
blocks.en: Disassembly and cleaning

blocks.zh: 稽查員會詢問：「您的風險評估是否涵蓋了故障情境下的交叉污染？」這是常見483觀察事項的來源。
blocks.en: Inspectors will ask: "Does your risk assessment cover cross-contamination under failure scenarios?" This is a common source of 483 observations.

blocks.zh: 類比：工廠規模與風險的非線性關係
blocks.en: Analogy: The Non-Linear Relationship Between Scale and Risk

blocks.zh: 指引特別指出「規模的影響可能是非線性的」。好比投100克時操作員可以很謹慎，但投100公斤時，物料洩漏的絕對量遠遠更大，且操作員疲勞度、粉塵飛散面積都不成比例地增加。在新產品引入大規模生產時，這點常被低估。
blocks.en: The guide points out that "the effect of scale may be non-linear". When charging 100 g, an operator can be very careful, but when charging 100 kg the absolute amount of material spilled is far greater, and operator fatigue and the area over which dust spreads increase disproportionately. This is often underestimated when a new product is introduced at large scale.

blocks.zh: ISPE重點提醒：GxP合規並非充分條件
blocks.en: ISPE Key Reminder: GxP Compliance Is Not a Sufficient Condition

blocks.zh: 指引明確指出，GxP的正確執行「通常可確保大多數製程具合理的密閉性」，但這僅是基線，並非足夠條件。針對每個製程的全面暴露評估仍是必要的，不能以「我們符合GMP」取代具體的風險識別與評估。
blocks.en: The guide states that correct execution of GxP "will normally ensure reasonable containment for most processes", but this is only a baseline, not a sufficient condition. A comprehensive exposure assessment for each process is still necessary; "we comply with GMP" cannot replace specific risk identification and assessment.

blocks.zh: 製程特性風險因素矩陣
blocks.en: Process Characteristics Risk Factor Matrix

blocks.zh: 以下製程特性均對交叉污染發生機率有直接影響：
blocks.en: The following process characteristics all have a direct effect on the probability of cross-contamination:

blocks.zh: Non-Processing Activities — 非製程活動
blocks.en: Non-Processing Activities

blocks.zh: p71–p72 | 廢棄物處理、計畫/非計畫維護、換批次、清潔作業
blocks.en: p71–p72 | Waste handling, planned/unplanned maintenance, changeover, cleaning operations

blocks.zh: 廢棄物管理的交叉污染盲點
blocks.en: Cross-Contamination Blind Spots in Waste Management

blocks.zh: 廢棄物處理（Waste Handling）常被忽視，但污染路徑真實存在：
blocks.en: Waste handling is often overlooked, but the contamination routes are real:

blocks.zh: 沾染產品的手套、口罩、過濾器——若未依規程廢棄，可能轉移污染
blocks.en: Product-contaminated gloves, masks and filters can transfer contamination if not disposed of according to procedure

blocks.zh: 共用清潔室（Common Cleaning Room）是最高風險區域：不同產品的髒設備與乾淨設備同時存在，極易交叉污染
blocks.en: A common cleaning room is the highest-risk area: dirty equipment and clean equipment from different products are present at the same time, making cross-contamination very easy

blocks.zh: 廢棄物路線設計應與生產流向完全分隔
blocks.en: Waste route design should be completely separated from the production flow

blocks.zh: 計畫性維護（PM）的七項最低審查要素
blocks.en: Seven Minimum Review Elements for Planned Maintenance (PM)

blocks.zh: ISPE明確列出計畫性維護評估的最低要求，這是稽查員常查閱的風險評估項目：
blocks.en: ISPE explicitly lists the minimum requirements for assessing planned maintenance; this is a risk assessment item that inspectors often review:

blocks.zh: 維護性質（如HVAC停機）
blocks.en: Nature of the maintenance (e.g. HVAC shutdown)

blocks.zh: 維護頻率（日、週、月、年）
blocks.en: Frequency of maintenance (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly)

blocks.zh: 維護發生時的生產狀態（區域乾淨或污染？）
blocks.en: Production status when the maintenance occurs (area clean or contaminated?)

blocks.zh: 是否有核准的PM程序
blocks.en: Whether an approved PM procedure exists

blocks.zh: 執行人員資格要求
blocks.en: Qualification requirements for the personnel performing it

blocks.zh: 人員培訓是否到位
blocks.en: Whether personnel training is in place

blocks.zh: 粉末洩漏可能性（如清空集塵器、吸塵單元時）
blocks.en: Potential for powder release (e.g. when emptying dust collectors or vacuum units)

blocks.zh: 關鍵問題：維護人員是否來自外部廠商？他們是否了解交叉污染控制要求？
blocks.en: Key question: are the maintenance personnel from an external contractor? Do they understand the cross-contamination control requirements?

blocks.zh: 非計畫性維護的FMEA思路
blocks.en: FMEA Thinking for Unplanned Maintenance

blocks.zh: 指引要求對非計畫性維護進行主動性審查——即在事故發生前，預先思考「如果HVAC突然停機，我們的應變SOP是什麼？交叉污染風險如何管控？」這與製造業的FMEA（失效模式效應分析）思路完全相同：預測失效，建立失效模式程序，而不是等到出事後才應急。
blocks.en: The guide requires a proactive review of unplanned maintenance: before an incident occurs, think ahead, "If the HVAC suddenly stops, what is our response SOP? How is cross-contamination risk controlled?" This is exactly the FMEA (failure mode and effects analysis) approach used in manufacturing: predict failures and establish failure mode procedures, rather than improvising after something goes wrong.

blocks.zh: 換批次（Changeover）管理要點
blocks.en: Key Points for Changeover Management

blocks.zh: 換批次是多產品廠房的最高風險節點，管控重點包括：
blocks.en: Changeover is the highest-risk node in a multi-product plant. Control priorities include:

blocks.zh: 換批次活動的順序：必須有書面程序且明確規定操作序列
blocks.en: Sequence of changeover activities: there must be a written procedure with a clearly defined operating sequence

blocks.zh: 模具/零件管理：以壓片衝頭（tablet punches）為例，換批時的取出、清潔、運輸、儲存都是潛在交叉污染點
blocks.en: Tooling/parts management: taking tablet punches as an example, removal, cleaning, transport and storage during changeover are all potential cross-contamination points

blocks.zh: 換批程序應包含確認清單（Checklist），並由QA人員最終放行
blocks.en: The changeover procedure should include a checklist, with final release by QA personnel

blocks.zh: 清潔作業本身的風險——DoE應用
blocks.en: The Risk of Cleaning Itself — Application of DoE

blocks.zh: 指引指出清潔本身也可能製造交叉污染，這是一個常被忽略的觀點。控制方向：
blocks.en: The guide points out that cleaning itself can also create cross-contamination, a view that is often overlooked. Control directions:

blocks.zh: 清潔程序應足夠詳細，確保人員可一致、正確執行
blocks.en: The cleaning procedure should be detailed enough for personnel to perform it consistently and correctly

blocks.zh: 運用DoE（實驗設計）識別清潔過程的關鍵參數（CPPs）
blocks.en: Use DoE (design of experiments) to identify the critical process parameters (CPPs) of the cleaning process

blocks.zh: CIP系統的CPPs（時間、溫度、壓力）須被監控、控制並設有警報
blocks.en: CIP system CPPs (time, temperature, pressure) must be monitored, controlled and alarmed

blocks.zh: 需明確定義CPP超標時的處置流程，並設定防止人員擅自干預的保護（如密碼鎖）
blocks.en: The response process when a CPP is out of limits must be clearly defined, with safeguards (such as password locks) to prevent unauthorized intervention

blocks.zh: CIP雖比手動清潔更一致，但前提是機械可靠性已被驗證。
blocks.en: CIP is more consistent than manual cleaning, but only if mechanical reliability has been verified.

blocks.zh: Facility and Equipment Design — 廠房與設備設計
blocks.en: Facility and Equipment Design

blocks.zh: p72–p73 | 密閉/開放系統定義、HVAC與設施設計因素
blocks.en: p72–p73 | Definition of closed/open systems, HVAC and facility design factors

blocks.zh: 密閉製程（Closed Process）的定義與舉證責任
blocks.en: Definition of a Closed Process and the Burden of Proof

blocks.zh: 密閉製程定義為：產品不暴露於直接的室內環境（反之亦然）。重要原則：
blocks.en: A closed process is defined as one in which the product is not exposed to the direct room environment (and vice versa). Key principles:

blocks.zh: 舉證責任在製造商：廠商必須定義何謂密閉，並提供密閉性的驗證證明
blocks.en: The burden of proof is on the manufacturer: the company must define what "closed" means and provide validation evidence of containment

blocks.zh: 典型例子：加壓容器、使用分蝶閥（Split Butterfly Valve）進行進料與排料的密封系統
blocks.en: Typical examples: pressurized vessels, and sealed systems using split butterfly valves for charging and discharging

blocks.zh: 密閉系統暴露變異性遠低於開放系統
blocks.en: The variability of exposure in a closed system is far lower than in an open system

blocks.zh: 開放製程（Open Process）——時間因素的考量
blocks.en: Open Processes — Considering the Time Factor

blocks.zh: 任何不符合密閉定義的製程均視為開放製程，包括：
blocks.en: Any process that does not meet the definition of closed is considered an open process, including:

blocks.zh: 分裝時的開放式物料處理
blocks.en: Open material handling during dispensing

blocks.zh: 造粒機刮碗操作
blocks.en: Granulator bowl scraping operations

blocks.zh: 流化床乾燥機出料時的碗體移除
blocks.en: Bowl removal at discharge of a fluid bed dryer

blocks.zh: 指引特別強調：開放時間的長短（Brief or Longer）應在風險評估中被考慮。即使僅短暫開放，如果物料的ADE極低，仍可能是顯著風險點。
blocks.en: The guide stresses that the length of the opening (brief or longer) should be considered in the risk assessment. Even a brief opening can still be a significant risk point if the material's ADE is very low.

blocks.zh: 一次通過空氣（Once-Through Air）的決策邏輯
blocks.en: Decision Logic for Once-Through Air

blocks.zh: HVAC是否採用迴風循環，是設計階段的重要決策：
blocks.en: Whether the HVAC uses recirculated air is an important design-stage decision:

blocks.zh: 一次通過空氣（OTA）：最嚴格的交叉污染控制，但能耗極高（冷熱能源不循環）
blocks.en: Once-through air (OTA): the strictest cross-contamination control, but with very high energy consumption (heating and cooling energy is not recovered)

blocks.zh: 迴風循環：顯著降低設施設計與運行成本，但必須確認迴風中的氣溶膠已被有效過濾
blocks.en: Recirculated air: significantly lowers facility design and operating costs, but it must be confirmed that aerosols in the return air are effectively filtered

blocks.zh: 決策依據是風險評估而非預設立場——如果迴風不增加不可接受的工作人員或交叉污染風險，迴風是可以接受的選項。詳細內容見第9.6節。
blocks.en: The decision is based on risk assessment, not a preset position: if recirculation does not add unacceptable risk to workers or of cross-contamination, recirculation is an acceptable option. See Section 9.6 for details.

blocks.zh: 廠房設計風險審查的七個維度
blocks.en: Seven Dimensions of the Facility Design Risk Review

blocks.zh: 設施與設備設計對交叉污染發生機率的影響是根本性的——設計決定了風險的「底線」，後期運行控制只是疊加在設計基礎上的管理層。審查範圍：
blocks.en: The influence of facility and equipment design on the probability of cross-contamination is fundamental: design sets the "floor" of the risk, and later operational controls are only a management layer on top of the design. Scope of the review:

blocks.zh: Product Exposure Risk in Non-Product Contact Areas — 非產品接觸區域的產品暴露風險
blocks.en: Product Exposure Risk in Non-Product Contact Areas

blocks.zh: p73–p75 | 區域分類、殘留物評估、可信度分析、暴露評估考量
blocks.en: p73–p75 | Area classification, residue assessment, plausibility analysis, exposure assessment considerations

blocks.zh: 皮膚暴露風險 vs 交叉污染風險——不要混淆
blocks.en: Dermal Exposure Risk vs. Cross-Contamination Risk — Do Not Confuse Them

blocks.zh: 指引特別澄清：某些廠商用拭子採樣/限度來評估員工的皮膚暴露風險（Dermal Risk），這不應與交叉污染風險評估混為一談。兩者目的不同：
blocks.en: The guide specifically clarifies that some companies use swab sampling/limits to assess employees' dermal risk, and this should not be conflated with cross-contamination risk assessment. The purposes differ:

blocks.zh: 皮膚暴露評估：保護工作人員（職業健康，IH）
blocks.en: Dermal exposure assessment: protects workers (occupational health, IH)

blocks.zh: 交叉污染評估：保護下一批次產品品質（GxP）
blocks.en: Cross-contamination assessment: protects the quality of the next batch of product (GxP)

blocks.zh: 採樣限度設定依據不同，不能互相替代使用。
blocks.en: The basis for setting sampling limits differs, so the two cannot be used in place of each other.

blocks.zh: 可信度評估的數量化方法（Plausibility Calculation）
blocks.en: Quantitative Method for Plausibility Assessment (Plausibility Calculation)

blocks.zh: ISPE提供了一個重要的量化思維工具：即使室內表面殘留量看似龐大，實際進入產品的量與ADE限度相比，往往差異懸殊。
blocks.en: ISPE provides an important quantitative thinking tool: even if the residue on room surfaces looks large, the amount that actually enters the product is often vastly different from the ADE limit.

blocks.zh:
計算邏輯：
最保守估計的房間表面總殘留量（mg）
        vs.
允許帶入Product B的最大量 = ADE_A × 最大日劑量單位數（mg）

安全邊際（Margin of Safety）= 允許量 / 估計殘留量

範例1（房間表面）：
  估計最大殘留 = 110 m² × 10,000 cm²/m² × 5 µg/25 cm²
               = 220,000 µg = 220 mg
  ADE允許量 = 50 µg × 100,000 劑量單位 = 5,000 mg = 5 g
  MoS = 5,000 mg / 220 mg ≈ 22.7  → 低風險

範例2（金屬舀匙）：
  最大殘留 = 2,900 cm² × 4 µg/cm² = 11,600 µg = 11.6 mg
  ADE允許量 = 5 g = 5,000 mg
  MoS = 5,000 mg / 11.6 mg ≈ 431  → 低風險
blocks.en:
Calculation logic:
Total surface residue in the room under the most conservative estimate (mg)
        vs.
Maximum amount allowed to carry over into Product B = ADE_A × maximum number of daily dose units (mg)

Margin of Safety (MoS) = allowable amount / estimated residue

Example 1 (room surfaces):
  Estimated maximum residue = 110 m² × 10,000 cm²/m² × 5 µg/25 cm²
               = 220,000 µg = 220 mg
  ADE allowable amount = 50 µg × 100,000 dose units = 5,000 mg = 5 g
  MoS = 5,000 mg / 220 mg ≈ 22.7  → low risk

Example 2 (metal scoop):
  Maximum residue = 2,900 cm² × 4 µg/cm² = 11,600 µg = 11.6 mg
  ADE allowable amount = 5 g = 5,000 mg
  MoS = 5,000 mg / 11.6 mg ≈ 431  → low risk

blocks.zh: 此計算方法的前提是最保守假設（所有殘留均為LOD值，且均能轉移至產品），實際風險更低。
blocks.en: This calculation rests on the most conservative assumptions (all residues are at the LOD value and all can transfer to the product), so the actual risk is lower.

blocks.zh: 暴露評估的12個考量點——實務應用清單
blocks.en: 12 Considerations for Exposure Assessment — Practical Checklist

blocks.zh: 6.5.4條列出的12項考量，在實際風險評估文件中應逐項記錄：
blocks.en: The 12 considerations listed in 6.5.4 should each be recorded in the actual risk assessment document:

blocks.zh: 操作、清潔、異常、維護期間的開放製程活動
blocks.en: Open process activities during operation, cleaning, abnormal events and maintenance

blocks.zh: 隔離屏障或產品房內的產品堆積與殘留
blocks.en: Product accumulation and residue in isolator barriers or product rooms

blocks.zh: HVAC迴風系統的氣溶膠保護是否充分
blocks.en: Whether aerosol protection in the HVAC return air system is adequate

blocks.zh: 風管內的粉塵堆積與壓差驅動的空氣傳播
blocks.en: Dust accumulation in ducts and pressure-driven airborne transfer

blocks.zh: 天花板上方、夾層空間、牆腔的洩漏
blocks.en: Leakage above ceilings, in interstitial spaces and in wall cavities

blocks.zh: HVAC/公用系統維護期間的殘留物
blocks.en: Residues during HVAC/utility system maintenance

blocks.zh: 人員服裝、手部、鞋底的攜帶轉移
blocks.en: Carry-over on personnel garments, hands and shoe soles

blocks.zh: 移動設備輪子攜帶的污染
blocks.en: Contamination carried on the wheels of mobile equipment

blocks.zh: 物料處理媒介（托盤、容器）的轉移
blocks.en: Transfer by material handling vectors (pallets, containers)

blocks.zh: 設備/隔離屏障的手動清潔
blocks.en: Manual cleaning of equipment/isolator barriers

blocks.zh: 緊急或異常情況
blocks.en: Emergency or abnormal situations

blocks.zh: 共用HVAC服務多個房間的情境
blocks.en: Scenarios where shared HVAC serves multiple rooms

blocks.zh: 非產品接觸區域的五層分類架構
blocks.en: Five-Tier Classification Framework for Non-Product Contact Areas

blocks.zh: ISPE建立了一個清晰的空間分類層次，對應不同的風險程度與監控要求：
blocks.en: ISPE establishes a clear hierarchy of spatial classification, corresponding to different risk levels and monitoring requirements:

blocks.zh: Detection — 偵測
blocks.en: Detection

blocks.zh: p75–p76 | 分析方法、PAT、藥典比對、控制充分性
blocks.en: p75–p76 | Analytical methods, PAT, compendia comparison, adequacy of controls

blocks.zh: 偵測（Detection）在風險評估中的角色
blocks.en: The Role of Detection in Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 在FMEA風險評估框架中，偵測能力是風險優先數（RPN）的三個維度之一：
blocks.en: In the FMEA risk assessment framework, detectability is one of the three dimensions of the risk priority number (RPN):

blocks.zh: 嚴重性（Severity）× 發生機率（Probability）× 偵測困難度（Detection） = RPN
blocks.en: Severity × Probability × Detection (difficulty of detection) = RPN

blocks.zh: ISPE的重要洞見：即使危害等級（Hazard Rating）高，若偵測方法靈敏且與健康限度直接關聯，整體風險仍可被有效管控並保持在低水平。這是「風險可管控」而非「風險不存在」的正確認知。
blocks.en: An important ISPE insight: even when the Hazard Rating is high, if the detection method is sensitive and directly linked to the health-based limit, the overall risk can still be effectively controlled and kept low. This is the correct understanding of "risk is controllable", not "risk does not exist".

blocks.zh: 目視檢查的限制——分析方法的重要性
blocks.en: Limits of Visual Inspection — the Importance of the Analytical Method

blocks.zh: 當偵測方法僅為目視檢查時，關鍵問題是：
blocks.en: When the detection method is only visual inspection, the key questions are:

blocks.zh: 員工的視覺靈敏度（Visual Acuity）是多少？
blocks.en: What is the employee's visual acuity?

blocks.zh: 安全殘留限度（Safe Level）與目視偵測下限的關係如何？
blocks.en: How does the safe residue level relate to the lower visual detection limit?

blocks.zh: 結論邏輯：
blocks.en: Concluding logic:

blocks.zh: 若安全限度 < 目視偵測下限 → 目視看不出不合格 → 高偵測風險
blocks.en: If the safe level < the lower visual detection limit → a failure cannot be seen by eye → high detection risk

blocks.zh: 若安全限度 >> 目視偵測下限（相差數個量級）→ 低偵測風險
blocks.en: If the safe level >> the lower visual detection limit (several orders of magnitude apart) → low detection risk

blocks.zh: 此邏輯與清潔驗證中的視覺偵測限度（VDL, Visual Detection Limit）設定直接關聯。
blocks.en: This logic is directly linked to setting the visual detection limit (VDL) in cleaning validation.

blocks.zh: 製程分析技術（PAT）作為偵測工具
blocks.en: Process Analytical Technology (PAT) as a Detection Tool

blocks.zh: PAT（Process Analytical Technology）正越來越廣泛地被整合進製程偵測：
blocks.en: PAT (Process Analytical Technology) is increasingly being integrated into process detection:

blocks.zh: NIR（近紅外光譜）、Raman光譜：非破壞性、即時的組成分析工具
blocks.en: NIR (near-infrared spectroscopy) and Raman spectroscopy: non-destructive, real-time composition analysis tools

blocks.zh: 端點監控：自動判定製程終點，減少對操作員主觀判斷的依賴
blocks.en: End-point monitoring: automatically determines the process end point, reducing reliance on the operator's subjective judgment

blocks.zh: ICH Q10要求：一旦建立PAT系統，應在藥品品質體系（PQS）框架下持續維護與改進，而非停留在驗證通過即可的靜態狀態。
blocks.en: ICH Q10 requires that once a PAT system is established, it should be continuously maintained and improved within the pharmaceutical quality system (PQS), rather than left in a static state once validated.

blocks.zh: 指引也點出組織壁壘問題：研發部門與商業生產部門之間的傳統分界，不應成為技術傳承的障礙。
blocks.en: The guide also points to the problem of organizational barriers: the traditional divide between R&D and commercial manufacturing should not become an obstacle to technology transfer.

blocks.zh: 藥典比對（Compendia Comparison）——監管底線
blocks.en: Compendia Comparison — the Regulatory Baseline

blocks.zh: 開發內部分析方法或替代方法時，有一條不可妥協的底線：
blocks.en: When developing in-house or alternative analytical methods, there is a non-negotiable baseline:

blocks.zh: 內部方法必須正式證明其靈敏度至少等同於藥典方法（USP、EP、JP）或監管機構認可的參考方法。
blocks.en: An in-house method must formally demonstrate sensitivity at least equivalent to the compendial method (USP, EP, JP) or a reference method recognized by the regulatory authority.

blocks.zh: 允許開發替代方法的合理原因包括：
blocks.en: Valid reasons for developing an alternative method include:

blocks.zh: 更高的靈敏度
blocks.en: Higher sensitivity

blocks.zh: 更好的穩健性（Robustness）
blocks.en: Better robustness

blocks.zh: 適合整合至PAT技術
blocks.en: Suitability for integration into PAT technology

blocks.zh: 操作便利性
blocks.en: Operational convenience

blocks.zh: 青黴素、β-內醯胺類藥物（Beta-Lactams）是監管機構最關注的典型品項，其分析方法的靈敏度要求特別嚴格。
blocks.en: Penicillins and beta-lactams are the typical products of greatest concern to regulators, and the sensitivity requirements for their analytical methods are especially strict.

blocks.zh: 實務思考：您的HVAC維護程序是否觸發了交叉污染風險評估？
blocks.en: Practical Reflection: Does Your HVAC Maintenance Procedure Trigger a Cross-Contamination Risk Assessment?

blocks.zh: 對照本節內容，思考以下問題：
blocks.en: Reflect on the following questions in light of this section:

blocks.zh: 您廠的HVAC計畫性保養（PM）是否有書面程序列出所有7項最低要素？
blocks.en: Does your plant's HVAC planned maintenance (PM) have a written procedure listing all 7 minimum elements?

blocks.zh: HVAC故障時，是否有預先定義的失效模式程序（Failure Mode Procedure）？
blocks.en: Is there a predefined failure mode procedure for HVAC failure?

blocks.zh: 您使用的清潔殘留分析方法，靈敏度是否優於或等同於USP/EP方法？有無正式比對記錄？
blocks.en: Is the sensitivity of the cleaning residue analytical method you use better than or equivalent to the USP/EP method? Is there a formal comparison record?

blocks.zh: 換批次（Changeover）SOP是否明確定義操作順序，並設有QA放行確認步驟？
blocks.en: Does the changeover SOP clearly define the operating sequence and include a QA release confirmation step?

blocks.zh: 控制措施充分性（Adequacy of Controls）的四項評估標準
blocks.en: Four Criteria for Assessing the Adequacy of Controls

blocks.zh: 指引要求在整個產品生命週期中，對所有採用的控制技術、設備與分析測試持續評估：
blocks.en: The guide requires continuous assessment, throughout the product lifecycle, of all control technologies, equipment and analytical tests in use:

blocks.zh: 若控制措施不一致，一旦偵測到超標，根本原因調查將極為困難——因為存在過多無法排除的變數。這正是指引強調控制措施一致性的核心理由。
blocks.en: If controls are inconsistent, once an out-of-limit result is detected, root cause investigation becomes extremely difficult, because there are too many variables that cannot be ruled out. This is the core reason the guide stresses consistency of controls.

blocks.zh: 本節核心摘要（Section 3b: 6.4–6.6 重點整理）
blocks.en: Section Summary (Section 3b: Key Points of 6.4–6.6)

blocks.zh: 6.4 發生機率：風險評估必須涵蓋設計、產品引入、變更控制及定期審查四個觸發點；手動操作、不穩定製程、操作節點轉換及人員變動是高發生機率的指標性因素。
blocks.en: 6.4 Probability of Occurrence: the risk assessment must cover four trigger points: design, product introduction, change control and periodic review; manual operations, unstable processes, transitions between operating nodes and personnel changes are indicator factors of high probability of occurrence.

blocks.zh: 6.4.1 生產活動：FAT僅測試最佳狀態，風險評估須延伸至設備設定、人工干預、故障、拆卸與清潔全部操作狀態；能量輸入（研磨、流化、壓縮）、轉移頻率與規模效應是核心考量因素。
blocks.en: 6.4.1 Production Activities: FAT tests only the optimal state, so the risk assessment must extend to all operating states: equipment set up, manual intervention, failure, disassembly and cleaning; energy input (milling, fluidization, compression), transfer frequency and scale effects are the core considerations.

blocks.zh: 6.4.2 非製程活動：廢棄物共用區、PM/EM計畫中的交叉污染路徑審查、換批次程序的文件化順序、CIP的CPPs監控與警報設計均為合規關鍵點。
blocks.en: 6.4.2 Non-Processing Activities: shared waste areas, review of cross-contamination routes in PM/EM programs, the documented sequence of the changeover procedure, and CIP CPP monitoring and alarm design are all key compliance points.

blocks.zh: 6.4.3 設施設計：密閉系統（Closed Process）有明確定義且舉證責任在製造商；HVAC是否採用一次通過空氣需風險評估決策，而非預設選擇。
blocks.en: 6.4.3 Facility Design: a closed process has a clear definition and the burden of proof is on the manufacturer; whether the HVAC uses once-through air requires a risk assessment decision, not a default choice.

blocks.zh: 6.5 非產品接觸區域：五層空間分類（Barriers → Product Room → Supporting → GxP → HVAC）；量化可信度計算顯示室內表面殘留對產品的實際風險往往遠低於ADE限度；暴露評估需涵蓋12個維度。
blocks.en: 6.5 Non-Product Contact Areas: five-tier spatial classification (Barriers → Product Room → Supporting → GxP → HVAC); the quantitative plausibility calculation shows that the actual risk to product from room surface residue is often far below the ADE limit; the exposure assessment must cover 12 dimensions.

blocks.zh: 6.6 偵測：偵測能力是RPN三維度之一；目視檢查方法需與安全限度比對；PAT（NIR/Raman）是先進偵測工具；內部方法必須至少等同於藥典方法靈敏度；控制措施需持續評估其適用性、時效性、重現性與穩健性。
blocks.en: 6.6 Detection: detectability is one of the three dimensions of the RPN; visual inspection methods must be compared against the safe limit; PAT (NIR/Raman) is an advanced detection tool; in-house methods must be at least as sensitive as compendial methods; controls must be continuously assessed for suitability, timeliness, reproducibility and robustness.
